source.title: Characterizing Desorbed Surface Contaminants Leading to Plasma Formation in Power Feeds of Pulsed Power Accelerators
source.page_text:
Figure 4.29: Allegra simulations at 60 ns into the current pulse of Mykonos shot 17133. The
images show the current, magnetic field across the gap, current density in the cathode, and
temperature in the cathode. The lineouts of each of the profiles shown are taken at either
the foil-edge location or the foil-middle location, as represented by Fig. 4.27, right panel.
[Simulation data courtesy of Alex Sarracino, Derek Lamppa, and Kyle Cochrane from Sandia
National Laboratories.]

middle locations. When compared to the assumption of a uniform distribution of atomic and

source.hash_validation: PDF, page content and decoded RGB mandatory; lossless PNG encoding may vary

simulation_context.snapshot_time_representation: Direct decimal-to-float seconds for nominal 40 ns/60 ns caption labels; no experimental clock registration.
simulation_context.observation_type: published legacy simulation coarse central-gap B_x lineout

unit_interpretation.source_gap_axis_label: Distance from Middle of AK Gap [mm]
unit_interpretation.primary_recovered_quantity: signed literal B_x plotted axis value
unit_interpretation.SI_columns_qualification: conditional literal printed factor 100 only; not a validated physical field input

selection.mask_basis: conservative central-gap display support separated from visible crossings, sheets and legend; no material-boundary reconstruction
selection.rule: one contiguous exact RGB run of 2–8 pixels away from ROI boundaries
selection.display_context_qualification: Exclusion context labels describe conservative display margins, not a claim that every omitted row is a crossing, sheet or occluded pixel.

readout_bounds.magnetic_recipe: entire matched [first_x,last_x] run extended by +/-2 pixels, exact fitted-axis map, then max absolute magnetic tick-fit residual
readout_bounds.gap_recipe: native row +/-2 pixels, exact fitted-axis map, then max absolute gap tick-fit residual

output.numeric_projection: Exact rational coordinates, bounds and conditional scale converted once to float, then CSV formatted to 12 significant digits.

limits: Published legacy Allegra simulation raster, not measured electromagnetic data or an actual FLASH result.
The central B_x component is signed negative on both coordinate halves; no sign flip from gap-coordinate sign is applied.
Only finite conservative central-gap support is recovered. Exteriors, crossings, sharp sheets, legend regions and exact surface fields remain excluded.
Nominal 200 µm foil spans about 7.9 native pixels on this gap axis; no skin-depth profile, derivative, Ampere/current or field-energy closure is supplied.
Original arrays, mesh, material fractions, moving boundaries, full vector fields and electromagnetic normalization are unavailable.
Conditional tesla columns do not establish physical magnitude, Hall transport, species magnetization, gap/host field acceptance or a physical coordinate-frame mapping.
Two nominal snapshots are not a registered field time history; no trigger or current-to-field alignment is inferred.
Readout bounds and adjacent raster samples are correlated display quantities, not physical uncertainty or independent observations.
